vectors.description: ASCII plaintext, deterministic salt and nonce
vectors.plaintext: Hello, world! This is a secret.

validation_rules: Given password + wire_hex → decrypt MUST produce plaintext
Given password + salt_hex + nonce_hex + plaintext → encrypt MUST produce wire_hex
Given password + wire_hex with last byte flipped → decrypt MUST fail with auth error
Given wrong password + wire_hex → decrypt MUST fail with auth error
